customer_info.notes: Attempted upgrade to Pro today; first time contacting support.

messages.text: Hi, I just tried upgrading to the Pro plan so I can use the Export feature, but the checkout page spun forever and timed out.
I tried two more times and my bank app now shows THREE pending charges of $29.99 ($89.97 total), yet my account is STILL on the Free plan and Export is locked!

I have an executive board presentation in 2 hours and desperately need to export my deck right now. If nobody fixes my Pro access and refunds these extra charges immediately, I am calling my bank to file a fraud dispute/chargeback!

customer_info.notes: Strategic Enterprise account in Thailand (ap-southeast-1) with P1 SLA.

messages.text: สวัสดีครับ ตอนนี้ทีมงานของเราเข้าใช้งานระบบไม่ได้เลย หน้าจอขึ้น HTTP Error 500 ตลอดเวลา

customer_info.notes: Active daily user on macOS Desktop v2.4.1; 0 prior tickets.

messages.text: Hey team! Love the app—I use it every day on my MacBook. I noticed a small quirk in the macOS desktop app (v2.4.1): when I set Appearance to 'System Default', the app stays stuck on Light theme even when macOS switches to Dark Mode.
Also, out of curiosity, do you have any plans to add a custom scheduled dark mode (e.g., automatically turn on dark mode at 7 PM)? No rush at all 😊 just wanted to ask!

customer_info.notes: Enterprise workspace using Okta SAML 2.0 SSO; rotated IdP signing certificate this morning.

messages.text: Hello Support, our IT security team rotated our Okta SAML 2.0 signing certificate this morning, and now SSO login fails with 'Invalid SAML Signature (ERR_SAML_CERT_MISMATCH)' for all 30 seats.

Password login is disabled by our workspace policy so there is no workaround for our team to sign in, though we don't have any external client demos today. Can an identity engineer update our SAML metadata XML on the backend?

customer_info.notes: Pro team workspace using Slack webhook notifications and REST API export.

messages.text: Hi there, our automated Slack webhook integration stopped posting daily digest notifications when a report contains more than 50 rows (logs show 'webhook payload size exceeded').
Right now we are working around it by downloading the CSV manually and sharing it in Slack, so we aren't blocked, but could a specialist check our webhook payload truncation setting when convenient?
